what: Vertically stacked panels each stick in place while you scroll their own height once their top edge reaches the top of the screen, and since no space is reserved (no pinSpacing), the next panel rises from below and covers the pinned one — a recruiting section where round-headed gradient panels stack like a deck of cards. Only at 768px and up.

options.[data-fx-part=block]: Panels to stick (children, several) — painted with a background so later panels cover earlier ones. Each panel sticks separately
options.min: Attached only at this width or wider (px), default 768 · 0 means all widths
options.end: Pin end — if absent, ScrollTrigger default (bottom top: as much as the panel height)

from.where: recruit.html .om-stack — a yellow-orange gradient panel (slogan·CEO message) and a heart panel inside a pink circular gradient stack up in turn, and the later panels (members·environment) cover them. Original ScrollTrigger.create({ pin: innerWidth >= 768, pinSpacing: false, start: 'top top' })
